World-class pizzeria
Jun 2026 • Family
A Japanese-run pizzeria that is very popular in Asia

A modern and beautiful restaurant with delicious and photogenic menus and craft beer, and the inside was full, with several Japanese guests present.

What I was given was a pizza with salad, chicken, and the most popular fresh cheese, a tom yum flavor pizza, and I forgot something else.

Everything was incredibly delicious, and the service was also very satisfying.

After returning, I wanted to research the stories of how Japanese people started businesses and trained employees in this place.

Since it seems it's also available at Azabudai Hills, I think I might check out the Tokyo store next.

Pizza To Go
Oct 2025 • Solo
I heard good things about the pizza here and ordered a 4 mushroom pizza to go.

Upon getting it back to my room I found it to be hot and ready to eat. It was piled with lots of mushroom topping and a nice creamy white sauces. The pizza drooped a little too much at the center when eating by hand and necessitated a slight fold over. The crust was thin and light and complemented the toppings.

I was quite hungry and finished off the regular size all on my own! 

A little pricier than other pizza joints here but delicious. Would reorder again next time I am craving a pizza in Vietnam.
